priorIterationResolution.priorFinding: FIND-018 (iteration-8, pure count/URL-diffing is unsound -- an unrelated post landing on any later wake gets silently misattributed to a stuck clip)
priorIterationResolution.note: REQ-008 step 6's redesign (behavioral-spec.md lines 196-233) now requires a per-href LIVE CAPTION fetch + exact-match compare against the sidecar's recorded caption for every element of new_hrefs, confirming ONLY when exactly one href's live caption matches. Hand-traced the exact FIND-018 counter-example: an unrelated post lands via the independent new-content pipeline, producing new_hrefs=[unrelated_href]; its live caption will differ from sidecar['caption'] (captions are per-clip and dynamic per the ground-truth section), so select_confirmed_href correctly returns None and the clip stays in $CLIP_PENDING_VERIFY rather than being misattributed. The logical structure of this fix is sound and closes FIND-018 as originally traced. However, this same redesign introduces two NEW critical gaps (FIND-021, FIND-022 below) that must be resolved before this closure can be trusted operationally.

priorIterationResolution.priorFinding: FIND-019 (iteration-8, no test catches the FIND-018 misattribution)
priorIterationResolution.note: verification-architecture.md PROP-006(b) (line 80) now concretely specifies the exact regression scenario: seed the sidecar, stub a candidate href belonging to an unrelated post, stub its live-caption-fetch to return a DIFFERENT caption text, and assert select_confirmed_href returns None + the clip stays pending + no ledger line + sidecar not deleted. This is a precise, implementable test for the driver-level logic. Note: this only tests the pure decision function and the driver's plumbing around an already-extracted caption string -- it does NOT test the actual browser-side caption extraction, which is the subject of NEW FIND-022.

REQ-008 step 3 (behavioral-spec.md lines 182-189) now concretely specifies: no placeholder is ever written; the clip is treated as permanently inconclusive; round-robin ordering no longer depends on the sidecar at all (moved to the clip file's own mtime, step 2). PROP-006(c) (verification-architecture.md line 80) specifies concrete tests for both a missing sidecar file and a corrupt/invalid-JSON sidecar, asserting no placeholder, no crash, no clip deletion, and clip-file mtime touched. This is precise enough for a builder to implement without guessing.
